notes.title: [1.5.10] Checkpoint update with new style items
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44152114/211c550a6d6a78e8d5b1cda066c6593d9a84a385.jpg[/img]

Hi, shooters! It's been a while since the last update. How was your 2025? We hope you had an amazing year filled with victories, epic moments, and, of course, tons of zombie-slaying action! This update focuses on quality of life. Well, let's see!

[b]Content[/b]
[list]
[*] Add 2 new faces: Heart Eyes, Sleepless Eyes
[*] Add new hats: Aloe
[/list]

[b]Quality of life[/b]
[list]
[*] Now each map has its checkpoint wave, which player can start at the checkpoint wave instead of starting from the beginning.
[*] Weapon loot randomization is now based on player's upgrade card. If you upgrade a lot of Assault Rifle, You'd have greater chance to get Assault Rifle.
[/list]

[b]Rebalance[/b]
[list]
[*] Reduce wave coin reward in most waves.
[/list]

[b]Bug Fixes[/b]
[list]
[*] Fix camera boundary works incorrectly in some maps.
[/list]

We’re always working to improve Around Us: Zombie Shooter, and your feedback helps shape the game. Try out the update and let us know what you think! 🚀

Thank you! Hope you enjoy!

notes.title: 1.4.0 Biggest update ever! New experience, upgrades and new map: Highway.
notes.notes:
[b][h2]Biggest update ever – Zombie Uprising: Experience Evolution![/h2][/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44152114/f1da8777414c0eb6a136dbda8ca97b16c4bfc6a0.png[/img]
Hello survivors!

It's been an incredible year since "Around Us: Zombie Shooter" launched in Early Access. We have some thrilling news to share!

[h3][b]$ Price Update[/b][/h3]
First, a heads-up: with this update, at version 1.4.0, the game's price will increase from $2.99 to $4.99.

[h1][b]Major Update: Version 1.4.0[/b][/h1]
We're excited to announce that our next big update, version 1.4.0, is now released.

[previewyoutube=gw5rLt3xves;full][/previewyoutube]
Let's see list of the update.

[h3][b]1. Challenge System[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] [b]Old System:[/b] Easy/Normal/Hard had all waves, with harder difficulties featuring higher damage/health multipliers.
[*][b]New Challenges:[/b] Each map now features various challenges, such as double health, boss rush, one-hit kills, etc.
[*][b]Unlocking Challenges:[/b] Each challenge require different number of badges (badge = number of challenges won) to unlock, default challenges which doesn't require any badge are Easy, Normal and Hard.
[*][b]Rewards: [/b]Winning challenges grants rewards and world records.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44152114/f9889d6c45e3f3cb9adc2bee9c84d0cf2504bc22.jpg[/img]

[h3][b]2. New Map: Highway[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*][b]Highway[/b] The fourth map of the game, Zombies can appoarches mainly two ways.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44152114/f929c5def526043c4b56e7e1582e7db6dd4c6476.png[/img]

[h3][b]3. New Zombies[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*][b]Armored Jumper[/b] Can jump and stomp to you, just like jumper, but a lot stronger.
[*][b]Stone zombie[/b] Very tough zombie, has high resistance to almost everything.
[*][b]Spike zombie[/b] Has spike skin. Better not to contact them.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44152114/75895483c44b8c73944fd2484cc051033fac0b63.png[/img]

[h3][b]4. New Boss: Crystal Boss[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*][b]Wave 70:[/b] A new boss, the Crystal Boss, will appear at wave 70.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44152114/b42491cdaa41a7230e314afd7518857daf2a138a.jpg[/img]

[h3][b]5. Perk Tree System[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*][b]Perk Books:[/b] Players can now gain "Perk Books" through rewards or loot boxes to upgrade unique passive abilities in the perk tree. Now with 12 first perks.
[*][b]First 12 Perks[/b] Critical Strke, Fast Learner, Spike Bat, Metal Bat, Safety Helmet, It's ok if no luck, Lucky One, Start Pack, Atleast A Pistol, Ghost Energy, Meaningful Death, Baby With A Gun.

[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44152114/eb6080277696a1bbb96a3101a87da963266164a0.png[/img]

[h3][b]6. New Super Cards[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*][b]Big heart:[/b] +50 max HP.
[*][b]Electromagnetics:[/b] Mines also release wide range of electo wave on explodes.
[*][b]Fire blessing:[/b] Inflict fire to anyone touch you.
[*][b]Auto shield:[/b] Give some amount of armor overtime.
[*][b]Woodoo doll:[/b] There's someone get hurt for you.
[*][b]All direction:[/b] Shotgun shoots all direction every 4th hit.
[*][b]Big arm:[/b] Change melee weapon to Big golem arms.
[*][b]Bounce shot:[/b] Sniper rifle bullet can bounce and automatically find enemy nearby.
[*][b]Grenade launcher:[/b] Change from bombs to grenade launcher.
[*][b](Rework) Blast shot:[/b] Add blast explosion effect instead of ordinary bomb effect and now needs to be charged for 1.5 s to shoot out blast shot.
[*][b](Rework) Explosive Proof:[/b] Instead of 100% self explosion resistance to reduce 50% explosion damage from allies. (include from yourself).
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44152114/d7a4816726ff67e650aff313977db6f30e71c645.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44152114/d743096771015d54eb6512259034fdc5462091a2.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44152114/e578e19346b6f24217f30efd18e61d4acc36db6e.gif[/img]

[h3][b]7. Skills can be upgrade[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*][b]Fireball:[/b] can be upgrade to Hellfire, Phoenix.
[*][b]Freeze:[/b] can be upgrade to Bigger Freeze, Ice Age.
[*][b]Heal:[/b] can be upgrade to Greater heal, Massive heal.
[*][b]Air Break:[/b] can be upgrade to Air Shake, World Break.
[*][b]Lightning Step:[/b] can be upgrade to Electric field, Phoenix.
[*][b]Light Beam:[/b] can be upgrade to Light Impact, Light Form.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44152114/f4c9bf69ddf05df0d85cd9ac84ce1731da73b2b0.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44152114/2c2b5d918abf77f7b82f9dd6cdf6a9850b5eb39e.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44152114/dedfc0e0dc700a275be6d28cd0e1199fb363b56e.png[/img]

[h3][b]8. Style System[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*][b]Customization Unlocks:[/b] Customizations will now be unlocked by opening loot boxes.
[*][b]New Customizations:[/b] 5 new colors added: Latte, Magenta, Lime, Light Pink, Inverse
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44152114/06238589e6e8f707d55faa3fd023bd033b181d14.png[/img]

[h3][b]9. Reward System[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*][b]Achievement Rewards:[/b] Earn coins, perk books, and loot boxes by completing achievements.
[*]Add new 10+ acheivements according to the update.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44152114/9e1caee731ed8f36da8663f7ce4a5f14cc616491.jpg[/img]


[h3][b]10. Improved UI[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*]Enhancements to the user interface for a better gameplay experience.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44152114/1b4b6e00cc1d260c61bb3ff3fcd4908c1b200c97.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44152114/c485ae351e9d880ce5a124c554f97f1a0869d317.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44152114/012b058e725e6ad99fa8d24df318b32ff36ef8dd.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44152114/a1100838312088c2b71169f2f716a29fda05b9b2.png[/img]

[h3][b]11. Improved Experience[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*][b]Aiming:[/b] now you can aim using right stick on gamepad, and hold "SHIFT" on keyboard. This would make you play easier!
[*][b]Camera mode:[/b] now you can change camera mode to third person shooter view. This will give you whole new experience.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44152114/276e4966b84651d5111cc4a62718761cc253ae37.png[/img]

[h3][b]12. General update & rebalances[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*]Reduced all zombie HP by 10-50%.
[*]Shortened wave times for faster, easier gameplay.
[*]Fewer zombies per wave.
[*]Change how zombie wave in maps work. Now each map has the same zombie set but different in map rule.
[*]Sightly improve stats of turrets.
[*]Now there's limit number of player who can choose the same upgrade card.
[*]Now player can't change choosing when selected an upgrade card.
[*]Add guard to reposition player to center of the map when going out too far (For case where player got bug and go outside the walls).
[*]After upgrade selection now only restore HP based on player count (instead of fully heal).
[*]Heart gift restores 75 HP instead of 50.
[*]On singleplayer now penalty waves has 30% shorter duration.
[*]On singleplayer now has 40% bonus score multiplier.
[*]Increase time before reduce stack from 3s to 4s.
[*]Increase stack bonus score by approx 5% per steps.
[*]Reduce zombie dmg, speed and amount multiplier.
[*]Now zombies won't spawn during pause.
[*]Add sound effect change hover buttons.
[*]Increase zombie score by about 5%
[*]Increase healing effectiveness of heart tower by 50%
[*]Increase most upgrade card value (e.g. from +20% to 25%)
[*]Reduce coin reward from casual plays.
[*]Fix bugs.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44152114/4d986d4d8d268b5e49334dbfead4e12f88d0fe56.png[/img]
We hope you're as excited about these updates as we are. Thank you for your continued support, and we'll see you in the game!

[i]Note: For DEMO and mobile version will be scheduled to get 1.4.0 update in following weeks.[/i]

Best,
The "Around Us: Zombie Shooter" Team

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44152114/f08af71fdcc4435e6cf74dd5b58c17fe76622128.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44152114/da365f662c5a64528a1b483fd4ac763878030076.jpg[/img]

[u][b]1. New content[/b][/u]
- Add new map: Frozen river.
- Add new zombie: Snow zombie. (exclusive for frozen river map)
- Add new boss: Centipede zombie.
- Extend wave limit from 50 to 60.
- Add 2 new debuffs: Cold, Freezed.
- Add new tower: frozen tower - Freeze entities in its radius.
- Now player can equip hats, starting with 11 hats.
- Thief zombie now skinned as Santa zombie.
- Rhino boss now skinned as Reindeer boss.

[u][b]2. Rebalance waves[/b][/u]
- Reduce time per wave of wave 21-50 by 10-30%.
- Reduce difficulty of single player waves.

[u][b]3. Rebalance zombies[/b][/u]
- Reduce duration of acid pool from 60s to 40s.
- Sightly increase HP of Hybrid, Rhino and big arm boss.

[u][b]4. Rebalance weapons & upgrades[/b][/u]
- Now most upgrade has no limitation.
- Now "Auto shot" also work with assault rifle and shotgun.
- Move "Auto shot" to tier 2 super card.
- Increase all turret firerate.

[u][b]5. Quality of life update[/b][/u]
- Now show percent amount of each upgrade.
- Add screenshake on explosions.
- Change how to play and upgrade button on main menu to icon.
- Add victory music.
- Loot box now changed to Christmas gift box.

[u][b]6. Fixes[/b][/u]
- Fix position of acid pool spawn
- Fix double pistol , bounce, homing upgrade
- Fix fire buff infliction
- Fix player character leave & join display incorrectly

[i]Note: this update may contain some bugs as some of the core system has reworked - if you get some issue you can contact us on Discord, Thank you.
[/i]

Hope you guys fun!
Discord: https://discord.com/invite/ZBHx3YUfAd

notes.title: Wave 40! A lot of new changes!?
notes.notes:
Hi, Zombie shooters! Currently the game has wave limit of 30, and yet no one seems to able to reach that wave. In this update we expand the limit to 40! Wave 10-30 will be rebalanced with new zombies and new spawn patterns. You would experience the change of gameplay, let's take a look to details.

[b][u]1. Major change, faster gameplay[/u][/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44152114/1db37a997c5be6e50229e40e5a5d0a7d1f57acd0.png[/img]

- Now zombies will spawn after 5-15 seconds after wave end (instead of wait untill all zombies killed)
- Now only wait for all zombies to be killed to end wave every 10 waves.
- Now only spawn all dead players every 10 waves.
- Upgrade card selection is now appear when the score is reached, instead of every wave end.
- Incease more variety of waves by adding 10 more spawn patterns.
- Zombie variation are now increased slower by waves than previous version.
- Reduce amount of zombie each wave.
- Easy mode now reduce amount zombie by 25%, Reduce zombie HP by 50% instead of 25%

[b][u]2. New zombie[/u][/b]
These are new zombies in this patch, you'll see them more on wave 30+, but as we tested, it very hard to get to that high level.
- Jumper: Can jump toward player and cause landing damage.
- Thief: Can steal player's items.
- Spider: Can release spider web to slow player.
- Insect: Create acid pool when dead.
- Miner: Attack player's traps.
- Rhino (Boss): Very big zombie, can charge and hit you.

[b][u]3. New mechanic on player respawn[/u][/b]
We observed that when playing multiplayer, dead player are just sitting and wait for minutes to respawn. So we decide to make a change.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44152114/9395b0a15b5efa8ca575e42150384bf0277db344.png[/img]

- Now dead player will become ghost, ghosts need to find a revive statue which will has a chance to appear every 10 seconds and has cooldown of 15-120 seconds.
- Ghosts can't attack of equip weapons and move very slow.
- All players still has free respawn at the end of wave 1,5,10,15,20,25,30,40.

[b][u]4. New contents[/u][/b]
- Add new card: Duo pistol
- Shotgun card: "More spread bullet" max level increased from 1 to 2

[b][u]5. Improvements[/u][/b]
- Now tower level 1,2,3 are different.
- Change join method from room list to join using room code.
- Add game intro.
- 40+ new steam achievements
- Now gun image, bullet count and hp bar sizes are increased by 200%

[b][u]4. Bug fixes & rebalance[/u][/b]
- Make these zombies weaker: Normal, digger, bomber, big, hybrid zombies.
- Reduce speed increase per card level from 12% to 10%.
- Now player only get 50% damage from own bombs.
- Increase fire damage per tick from 16 to 17.
- Player now can't get damage in first 3 second after spawned.
- Fix mouse cursor disappear when leave room.
- Fix bug zombie can attack dead players.
- Fix bomb graphic not shown on remote players.
- Fix player still get score from dead zombies after wave ended.
- Fix bug start game more than once.
- Fix barrel won't respawn when play new match

Hope you enjoy!
